flows.name: NoizyAudioHarvestAndNormalize
flows.description: Monitors Windows desktop audio ingest, triggers FFmpeg 24-bit 48kHz WAV normalization, and mirrors to /Volumes/NOIZYWIN.

flows.name: NoizyD1MemCellsMirror
flows.description: Pulls daily Cloudflare D1 MemCells export and maintains an offline Windows SQLite replica on NOIZYWIN.

flows.name: NoizyDirectMLVoiceSynth
flows.description: Executes local ONNX/DirectML voice synthesis pipeline on Windows 11 GPU emulation.

flows.name: NoizySovereignBrowserRPA
flows.description: Automates Windows Edge / Chrome sovereign workflow tasks, reporting, and CRA / invoice validation.
